stories.title: Inside a Wrigleyville rooftop owner's fight with the Cubs
stories.summary: Will the last holdout in Wrigleyville be able to stand up to the Chicago Cubs?

stories.title: RB Barkley, WR Smith among 5 Eagles ruled out for London game vs. Jags
stories.summary: Eagles running back Saquon Barkley, receiver DeVonta Smith, new starting center Drew Kendall, safety Marcus Epps and receiver Hollywood Brown were all ruled out for Sunday's game in London against the Jaguars.

stories.title: Legendary coach, Hall of Fame TE Ditka dies at age 86
stories.summary: Mike Ditka, a Hall of Fame tight end who became an NFL legend for his time as coach of the Bears, has died at the age of 86.

stories.title: Grand closing, grand opening: Guardians go back to Williams to start Game 5
stories.summary: After finishing Game 4 of the ALDS on the mound, Guardians right-hander Gavin Williams will get the ball to start Game 5, while the White Sox will go with righty Sean Burke.

stories.title: Webb: 'Not ideal' to lose Broncos' play-calling duties
stories.summary: Broncos offensive coordinator Davis Webb said that "it's not ideal" to have been stripped of playcalling duties, but said he plans to "be the best offensive coordinator I can be."
